The new 3-question "Questions about Custom" section is written in `app/pricing/page.tsx`, after the "After launch" FAQ. Nothing is committed. I haven't checked it in a browser or run any tests, and the copy checker (`check:copy`) didn't run because this worktree has no `node_modules`.

I also added the three questions to the page's FAQ structured data (`faqLd`, the schema.org JSON-LD), so it matches what's visible. Drop that if you want the section on-page only.

The questions and answers, with every figure read from `lib/pricing.ts`:

1. **What does Custom include that Starter does not?** Up to 10 pages and 5 templates. Type, layout and motion are drawn for your brand alone, and site search is built in at no extra fee. Starter is one page on a ready-made site.
2. **Do I need to bring my own photos?** Yes. Photography is yours and we design around it. We do not supply images.
3. **What does Custom cost, and what do I pay after launch?** From $1,999 one-off, fixed and agreed in writing before we start. Care is $85 a month with hosting included, and has a 12-month minimum, then runs month to month.

For your review, I wrote one thing you didn't ask for: the heading "Questions about Custom", which I added so the section has a label. It also sets the three questions apart from the main FAQ above it.

The answers only restate facts already in `lib/pricing.ts` and the existing FAQ, so nothing is invented. Your rule about not writing display copy alone applies to the heading and the question wording, so check those two first.
